g.text: H1 price gap, Claude Haiku 5.5, after Holm (m = 8)

rect.style: stroke-width: 1px; stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke-opacity: 0; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 0;

text.tspan: Flagged at least 80% of the time; about
$14,100 per $1M of agent spend
= $0.37 per purchase at the $26.47 average paid
Set from the Haiku pilot before the main run.
GPT-6 Luna: none set in advance; post hoc 1.4%
(this run's achieved gap, no Holm)

text.tspan: THREE PROPOSED ACTIONS FOR A PAYMENTS NETWORK

text.tspan: 1 Audit gate (do now)

rect.style: stroke-width: 1px; stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke-opacity: 0; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 0;

text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; fill: rgb(31, 31, 28); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: An agent joins the network's agent program only after
passing this paired-name audit, and again after every
model update. Fail if a gap is found after correction;
if inconclusive, re-run larger. Cost: about $10 per model
at batch prices (pre-run estimate).

text.tspan: Every agent purchase logs the model version, the
identity fields the agent saw, products shown, the
choice and the price, so a dispute can be checked.

in place of the display name unless shipping
needs it. When a needed preference is missing,
the agent asks.
